# Any scope where scope:oe_theme_seat is saved: counts BYZ/ROM-owned locations in the seat's region.
# Avoids temporary variables (zero PREVIEWVAR) and works before buildings finish construction.
oe_t2_seat_region_size = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire
            exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire
            exists = scope:oe_theme_seat
            scope:oe_theme_seat = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
        }
        global_var:oe_phoenix_empire = {
            every_owned_location = {
                limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_theme_seat.var:oe_theme_region }
                add = 1
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_t2_half_gold = {

oe_t2_half_manpower = {

# Theme scope. Guarded estrangement ordering key (least loyal first; safe even before first monthly tick).
oe_t2_estrangement = {
    value = 100
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty }
        subtract = var:oe_theme_loyalty
    }
}

# BYZ/ROM scope. Count of themes currently below 38 loyalty (eligible for Joint Petition crisis).
oe_t2_restless_theme_count = {
    value = 0
    every_subject = {
        limit = {
            oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
            has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty
            var:oe_theme_loyalty < 38
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
        }
        add = 1
    }
}

# Theme scope (receiving theme); scope:recipient is the theme being consolidated.
# Combined jurisdiction hub count after consolidation (v26.0 WP11 ceiling <= 95 hubs).
oe_t2_combined_jurisdiction_size = {
    value = oe_theme_jurisdiction_size
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
        scope:recipient = {
            every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
                limit = { oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = yes }
                add = 1
            }
        }
    }
}
